description.en: A SPARQL endpoint of Taiwan Indigenous People provides Taiwan Indigenous people information, including 6 major subjects : [Ethnic](http://lod.apc.gov.tw:8890/schemas/Ethnic_Introduction/), [Culture](http://lod.apc.gov.tw:8890/schemas/Cultural_Creative/), [Travel](http://lod.apc.gov.tw:8890/schemas/Travel/), [Gourmet](http://lod.apc.gov.tw:8890/schemas/Gourmet/), [Ceremony](http://lod.apc.gov.tw:8890/schemas/Ceremony/) and [Business] (http://lod.apc.gov.tw:8890/schemas/Business/).

sparql.title: SPARQL endpoint of Taiwan Indigenous People
